test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six houses Blue, Green, Red, Yellow, Orange, and Purple are arranged in a circle facing towards the center. The Blue house is second to the right of the Green house and opposite to the Orange house. The Yellow house is exactly between the Red and Orange houses. The Purple house is opposite to the Yellow house. Which house is to the immediate right of the Blue house?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) The Blue house is second to the right of the Green house and opposite to the Orange house. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eedbf49183adbd94330de621f118497c685b3d342b3a87342a90d46e2c550dbd.png] 

2) The Yellow house is exactly between the Red and Orange houses
.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/112e0d00f3a11a84104a9e75e53d3295fc49294d3bff61ec48d24025146090e1.png] 

3) The Purple house is opposite to the Yellow house.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cd2488a5dd512f5d996bab27ec4479612bde4531dec0057d8391488db91117f.png] 

Here, we can see that the Red house is to the immediate right of Blue house.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Red"**.
